name: tax identification number (TIN)
note: Cyprus's sheet (its government's own sheet on the OECD's automatic-exchange portal ('Information on Tax Identification Numbers'; the OECD's index page sits behind a bot check and wasn't opened, the sheet itself came straight back)), read 2026-10-30: (dated 28 April 2023) the Tax Administration issues TINs under articles 5 and 5A of the Assessment and Collection of Taxes Law 1978; an individual obliged to register must obtain one, and none is issued to those not obliged; eight numbers and a capital Latin check letter (its algorithm isn't given, `check` left out). Read as given on application, to anyone obliged. No age, fee or time is stated.

sources.title: OECD AEOI portal, Cyprus: Information on Tax Identification Numbers (the jurisdiction's own sheet)
sources.said: It is the responsibility of the obliged individual to register and obtain TIN. No TIN is issued to individuals who are not obliged to register. ... 99999999L 8 numbers followed by a letter
